(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly focuses on national-scale (Slovakia) land use/land cover (LULC) prediction to 2040. It implements five distinct future scenarios (including TREND, A1, A2, B1, B2) with quantitative comparisons of LULC transitions such as urbanisation, agricultural intensification/extensification, and afforestation. The study uses spatially explicit modeling (boosted regression trees within the CLUmondo framework) at 20-m resolution, reports quantitative accuracy metrics (AUC > 0.73, correlation coefficients), and produces mapped projections of future LULC changes across the entire country. All core inclusion criteria are met, and none of the exclusion criteria apply.)
